data.action: 双脚站稳反复练习广播体操，双臂平伸而神情认真。
data.description: （名场面延展）清晨无人的庭院，她穿着运动服认真到近乎悲壮地反复练习广播体操动作，汗水湿透了 T 恤；表情严肃得像在备战奥运，反差感拉满。
data.promptProse: Ai Hayasaka practices a radio-exercise movement with almost solemn concentration in the empty courtyard, raising her arms through the routine. Her blue sports T-shirt is damp from effort above grey tracksuit trousers, blonde side ponytail moving with the pose. The medium portrait includes the courtyard paving and garden boundary behind. Low sunrise lights her sleeve edges and fine forehead sweat, stretching her arm-and-body shadow over the quiet ground.
data.title: 早坂爱 · 广播体操的秘密特训
